facts.fact: The Adwave guide states that HIPAA limits how healthcare practices can use patient information for marketing.
facts.quote: HIPAA limits how you can use patient information for marketing.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide states that offering rewards for patient reviews violates most platform policies.
facts.quote: Offering rewards for reviews violates most platform policies and can backfire if discovered.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide states that platform policies restrict some health-related advertising claims and targeting options.
facts.quote: Platform policies restrict some healthcare advertising. Review platform guidelines carefully.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide states that a single new patient relationship can generate thousands in revenue over years.
facts.quote: A single new patient relationship can generate thousands in revenue over years.

facts.fact: The Adwave guide page was published on 2026-02-13.
Adwave states that its TV advertising campaigns start at $30 a day.
facts.quote: with campaigns starting at just $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave states that streaming TV advertising is available at budgets starting as low as $50, without specifying a time period.
facts.quote: Streaming TV makes television accessible at budgets starting as low as $50, eliminating the barrier

facts.fact: The page states that industry benchmarks suggest established medical practices spend 2-5% of revenue on marketing.
facts.quote: Industry benchmarks suggest 2-5% of revenue for established practices, with newer practices or those in competitive markets potentially investing more.

facts.fact: The page gives an example that a practice generating $500,000 annually might allocate $10,000-25,000 to marketing.
facts.quote: A practice generating $500,000 annually might allocate $10,000-25,000 to marketing.

facts.fact: The page states that HIPAA limits the use of patient information for marketing.
facts.quote: HIPAA limits use of patient information for marketing.

facts.fact: The page states that some jurisdictions restrict patient referral incentives and practices should check regulations before offering rewards.
facts.quote: Some jurisdictions restrict patient referral incentives. Check regulations before offering rewards.

facts.fact: The page states that formal referral agreements between practices and referral partners must comply with anti-kickback regulations.
facts.quote: though these must comply with anti-kickback regulations.
